page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 24 vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 186.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled directly with the instance, consisting of four local NVMe SSDs totaling 1343 GB of high-speed local storage capacity. No dedicated GPUs are included in this configuration.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-threaded capabilities, with Geekbench single-core scores and single-threaded gzip compression rates placing the server in the top 10% tier. Multi-core performance is also robust, with Geekbench multi-core and image processing benchmarks ranking in the top 25%. The Intel Xeon processor includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and integer operations, which support accelerated mathematical and cryptography workloads. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only small block cached speeds of 2024.01 GB/sec, while large block uncached read and write speeds reach 153.52 GB/sec and 56.59 GB/sec respectively.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4-highmem-24-lssd offers a dense allocation of memory and high-speed local NVMe storage relative to its 24 vCPUs, making it a viable option for workloads requiring fast local disk access without the overhead of external network storage. This resource profile is highly suited for memory-intensive databases, caching layers such as Redis, software compilation, and data processing tasks that benefit from high single-core performance and local scratch space.
